subject: SignalWave onboarding — API keying, seat migration, and role mapping
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@signalwave.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SignalWave onboarding — API keying, seat migration, and role mapping

Hi Anna,

Great to meet you on the kickoff call yesterday — excited to get SignalWave onto Redwood. I wanted to capture the initial plan and ask a few quick questions so we can prepare the initial tenant. Summary / asks below: 

High-level plan (proposed):
- Create two projects: signalwave-prod (locked) and signalwave-staging (for validation).
- Seed two long-lived service keys (one per project) + recommend rotating on a 30-day cadence.
- Invite admin users and map roles (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Developer).
- Migrate existing API usage: you mentioned ~3 integrations to be moved over this quarter.

Quick asks for our end: 
1) Primary admin email for org-level invites (who should receive Org Admin)?
2) Do you want separate service accounts per integration, or one shared service account per project?
3) Any SSO/SCIM setup planned this quarter (we can postpone if not)?
4) Desired go-live date for production cutover (we had tentatively targeted 2026-03-24).

Attached is a short checklist that outlines what we’ll provision from our side and what we’ll ask your team to confirm. If you’re OK with the above we’ll: 1) create the two projects and seed keys in a staging tenant, 2) send invites to the admin list you provide, 3) share the keying map and rotation schedule.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Jonas and Neha for the keying and seat migration specifics.

—
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: signalwave_initial_onboard_checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Anna Park <anna@signalwave.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalWave onboarding — API keying, seat migration, and role mapping

Thanks Soojin — this looks good. Answers below inline: 

1) Primary admin: anna@signalwave.io (I'll be the initial org admin).
2) Service accounts: Prefer separate service account per integration (3 total). We want least-privilege.
3) SSO/SCIM: We'll enable SSO in Q2; for now we'll manage invites manually.
4) Go-live: 2026-03-24 still achievable, but would prefer a 48-hour buffer if we run into key rotation issues.

Couple of follow-ups:
- Can Redwood issue env-specific keys that are scoped to projects and limited to specific endpoints? We want to ensure prod keys are restricted.
- Procurement has asked for a short runbook that shows how keys are rotated and what logs we’ll have access to for audits — can you attach that? procurement@signalwave.io is CC'd.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Anna Park
Technical Program Manager | SignalWave Inc.
anna@signalwave.io

On Thu, Mar 12, 2026 at 9:15 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Anna,
> 
> Great to meet you on the kickoff call yesterday — excited to get SignalWave onto Redwood....
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SignalWave onboarding — need env-specific keys + seat migration

Jonas / Neha — forwarding Anna's reply. TL;DR: they want 2 projects (prod/staging), 3 integration-specific service accounts (prod+staging per integration ideally), and a short runbook for procurement on key rotation + audit logs. Tentative cutover 2026-03-24 but ask for 48h buffer.

Proposed implementation plan (from implementation side):
- Provision projects: signalwave-prod, signalwave-staging.
- Create per-integration service accounts: sig-integ-payments, sig-integ-search, sig-integ-analytics. Each will get a prod and staging key (6 keys total).
- Key scoping: restrict prod keys to model/generate and embeddings endpoints only, and restrict staging keys to non-prod endpoints. We support that with policy tags on keys.
- Rotation: we’ll seed an initial long-lived key (30d rotation cadence) and provide rotation playbook. For immediate safety, we can issue expiring staging keys (48h) for early validation.
- Invitations: Invite anna@signalwave.io as Org Admin, create roles for two billing contacts and 2 developers.
- Migration: we will create a cutover checklist and a rollback plan — estimate 3 hours of coordinated work during cutover window.

Attachments: signalwave_keying_map.csv (CSV) — I started a mapping of integrations to service accounts. Please review and update slots for policy scoping.

Can you confirm the above and add any constraints (quota, per-minute rate-limits, or special audit fields) before I push to provisioning? I can schedule provisioning for Tue 2026-03-16 if you confirm.

—
Soojin

[Quoted message from Anna below]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@signalwave.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@signalwave.io
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalWave onboarding — API keying, seat migration, and role mapping

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming next steps and timeline: 

Action items (we'll execute these on Wed 2026-03-18 unless you ask us to delay):
- Redwood: create signalwave-staging and signalwave-prod projects. (Jonas)
- Redwood: seed per-integration service accounts and provide initial keys (6 keys: 3 prod, 3 staging). Staging keys will be RFC3339-expiring (48h) for validation; prod keys will be issued as rotatable keys with 30d recommended cadence. (Neha)
- SignalWave: confirm list of 4 users to invite (Org Admin, 2x Developer, Billing). Reply to this thread with emails. (Anna)
- Redwood: share runbook + audit log example and short procurement summary PDF by EOD Wed. (Soojin)

Security notes: prod keys will be scoped to generation and embeddings endpoints and will have a tag preventing export via UI. We will enable token-level logging for all prod requests; logs will be available in the link below for 90 days.

Links / attachments:
- Provisioning folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SignalWaveOnboard
- Initial key map: signalwave_keying_map.csv (attached)
- Onboard checklist: signalwave_initial_onboard_checklist.pdf (attached)
- Procurement summary (coming EOD Wed): short PDF that lists rotation cadence, audit retention, and a sample compliance snapshot.

Please confirm the 4 invite emails and whether you want the prod keys restricted further (IP allowlist, shorter TTL). If I don't hear otherwise we'll proceed Wed morning.

Thanks,
—
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: signalwave_keying_map.csv (CSV), signalwave_initial_onboard_checklist.pdf (PDF)
